name: Appwrite
shortDescription: Production-Ready Open-Source Backend Server for Secure & Scalable App Development
about: Appwrite is a powerful open-source backend platform designed to help developers build secure, scalable web and mobile applications faster. When deployed on your VPS, Appwrite gives you full control over your backend infrastructure including authentication, databases, file storage, and serverless functions without depending on third-party cloud providers. Hosting Appwrite on a VPS ensures better performance, predictable costs, and complete ownership of your data.
useCases: Ideal for startups, SaaS founders, agencies, and full-stack developers building production-ready applications. Appwrite removes backend complexity so teams can focus on shipping features instead of managing infrastructure.
performance: For optimal performance, Appwrite runs best on an 8GB or higher VPS with dedicated CPU resources. This ensures smooth database queries, reliable function execution, and stable API performance under load.

whyDeploy.title: 1. Complete Data Ownership
whyDeploy.description: Self-hosting Appwrite on your VPS means your user's data stays fully under your control no vendor lock-in and no external data sharing.

whyDeploy.title: 2. Predictable Monthly Costs
whyDeploy.description: Avoid per-request or per-user billing models. A VPS gives you fixed pricing and unlimited backend usage.

whyDeploy.title: 3. Better Performance & Low Latency
whyDeploy.description: Deploy Appwrite close to your target audience and deliver faster API responses compared to shared cloud platforms.

whyDeploy.title: 4. Scalable Infrastructure
whyDeploy.description: Start with 8GB RAM and scale vertically as your application grows without migrating to another provider.

whoShouldHost: Developers building SaaS products, internal company tools, marketplaces, mobile apps, or client projects who need a secure and flexible backend solution.
deploymentType: Docker-based (recommended) or manual installation on Ubuntu VPS.
